name: Alto DUSD
oneLiner: DUSD is Alto's overcollateralized USD stablecoin minted from isolated on-chain markets backed by ETH, BTC, and yield-bearing variants, with a 5M USDC PSM.
collateral: Over-collateralized on-chain assets in isolated lending markets on Ethereum: mint markets accept WETH, wstETH (Lido), rETH (Rocket Pool), mETH (Mantle LST), sUSDe (Ethena), and Syrup USDC; borrow markets accept cbBTC, WBTC, tBTC, sUSDe, Syrup USDC, and PAXG; each market is independently isolated with per-asset risk parameters; a Peg Stability Module enables 1:1 USDC↔DUSD swaps capped at 5M USDC
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized minting via isolated lending markets (mint and borrow); peg backstopped by a PSM enabling 1:1 USDC↔DUSD swaps at 0.20% fee (5M USDC cap); arbitrageurs exploit the PSM rate vs. market price to restore peg; all markets governed by ALTO token holder votes

mintAuthority.summary: DUSD is minted in Alto mint markets against posted collateral subject to per-market debt ceilings, with a capped USDC PSM that can mint/burn DUSD 1:1 before fees. ALTO staking grants governance power and fee sharing, while live admin executors still need direct on-chain role review.

controls.label: Alto isolated mint markets (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by per-market debt ceilings and collateral risk parameters.
controls.evidence: Alto docs distinguish borrow markets from mint markets and state that mint markets create new DUSD against posted collateral, capped by market-level debt ceilings.

controls.label: Alto DUSD/USDC PSM
controls.capDescription: The public PSM can mint DUSD against USDC and burn DUSD for USDC, bounded by a 5,000,000 USDC capacity and 0.20% fee.
controls.evidence: Alto PSM docs state that USDC->DUSD swaps mint new DUSD, DUSD->USDC swaps burn DUSD, and the PSM refuses swaps above the configured 5,000,000 USDC capacity.

controls.label: Alto governance and admin executors
controls.evidence: Alto docs describe ALTO staking as the governance-power mechanism, but the live Owner/Pauser/Freezer execution path was not independently read on-chain.

review.evidence: Alto docs describe DUSD mint markets that create new DUSD against collateral subject to debt ceilings and a capped PSM that mints/burns DUSD against USDC; docs also describe ALTO staking governance, but not enough live role data to assert direct ALTO-token-holder control of admin execution.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Market/PSM mechanism and ALTO governance confirmed from Alto docs; on-chain market admin owner and governance execution path not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain Alto market admin/owner, PSM owner/cap admin, and Owner/Pauser/Freezer or governance execution authorities on Ethereum.
